reviews.text:
We had a wonderful experience working with Portland Painting & Restoration. They completely restored our exterior siding with a fresh new stain and also painted several interior walls. The quality of their work was excellent.

What really made the experience stand out, though, was the people. Alex, our Project Manager, and Lexi, our Project Coordinator, were absolute gems. They were responsive, organized, incredibly easy to work with, and genuinely cared about making sure everything went smoothly.

The team also went above and beyond by helping us coordinate other trusted trades for additional exterior and interior projects, which was such a huge help. That level of service is hard to find these days.

I wouldn't hesitate to recommend Portland Painting & Restoration and will absolutely be working with them again on future projects!

Best decision we've ever made for our home - going with the crew from Portland Painting & Restoration! Skilled, professional, personable, reliable. They coordinated carpentry work to remove multiple areas of dry rot, rebuild our front-stair railing to be more in line with our house's architecture, and renovate our aging back deck. They also connected us with a lovely color designer. We couldn't be more pleased!

As a born Portlander, I look for businesses that have a track record in the local area for great results over time.  I know that more than advertising, their future lies in satisfied customers and a market reputation that is brand solid.

PP&R fits that model. And they exceeded my expectations.  First, they listened to our needs. Second, they delivered a competitive bid that included solutions we hadn't considered.  Third, I can;t say enough for the crew.  All of the team members we met (and I think we met them all!) were professional, thoughtful and considerate.

All along, it was clear our happiness was their goal.  I cannot recommend PP&R highly enough.

Portland Painting and Restoration came to my rescue after a disastrous experience with a remodeling company which ruined three elegant doors, parts of the old oak flooring, and a interior wall and staircase. Out of four bids, PPR gave me the most detailed quote and was the only company that seemed confident they could bring my home back to its original beauty. Not only did they more than meet my expectations, every one of the employees were specialized in their areas of expertise and a complete delight to work with. I'd hire them again in a heartbeat.

So extremely happy with PPR's work! They painted the entire exterior of my 1920s craftsman and did all the leg work to coordinate with the lead paint removal company as well. We encountered some challenges along the way, but the team was communicative and professional throughout (shout-out to Alex, Abe, and Lexi!), and did an outstanding paint job to boot! They really brought my craftsman back to life. I can't thank them enough. If you're considering any paint and restoration, I highly recommend PPR!
